resolved.title: break 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]break[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Infinite loops may sound cool, but they’re not always useful.

To end a [b]while [/b]loop prematurely, we can use a [b]break[/b] statement. 

For example, we can break an infinite loop if some condition is met:[code format="py" codeId="3916"]i = 0
while True:
  print(i)
  i = i + 1
  if i >= 5:
    print("Breaking")
    [b]break[/b]

print("Finished")[/code]
[b]while True[/b] is a short and easy way to make an infinite loop.

[b]An example use case of break:[/b]
An infinite while loop can be used to continuously take user input. For example, you are making a calculator and need to take numbers from the user to add and stop, when the user enters [b]"stop"[/b].

In this case, the [b]break [/b]statement can be used to end the infinite loop when the user input equals "stop".
[note]Using the [b]break [/b]statement outside of a loop causes an error.[/note]

content.text:
无限循环可能听起来很酷，但它们并不总是有用。

为了提前结束一个 **while** 循环，我们可以使用一个 **break** 语句。

示例如下：如果满足某些条件，我们可以中断一个无限循环。
content.text_html:
Infinite loops may sound cool, but they’re not always useful.

To end a **while **loop prematurely, we can use a break statement.

For example, we can break an infinite loop if some condition is met:

无限循环可能听起来很酷，但它们并不总是有用。

为了提前结束一个while 循环，我们可以使用一个break语句。

例如，如果满足某些条件，我们可以中断一个无限循环。

content.content:
i = 0
while True:
  print(i)
  i = i + 1
  if i >= 5:
    print("Breaking")
    break

print("Finished")

content.text:
**while True** 是一种短小精悍的方法，用于制造无限循环。

**break** 实例：

一个无限的while循环可以用来连续获取用户的输入。例如，你正在做一个计算器，需要从用户那里获取数字进行加法，当用户输入 **"stop"** 时，就停止。

在这种情况下，**break** 语句可以用来在用户输入等于 "stop" 时结束无限循环。

resolved.title: continue 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]continue[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Another statement that can be used within loops is [b]continue[/b]. 
Unlike [b]break[/b], [b]continue [/b]jumps back to the top of the loop, rather than stopping it. Basically, the [b]continue [/b]statement stops the current iteration and continues with the next one.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3917"]i = 0
while i<5:
  i += 1
  if i==3:
    print("Skipping 3")
    continue
  print(i)[/code]
[b]An example use case of continue:[/b]
An airline ticketing system needs to calculate the total cost for all tickets purchased. The tickets for children under the age of 3 are free. We can use a while loop to iterate through the list of passengers and calculate the total cost of their tickets. Here, the [b]continue[/b] statement can be used to skip the children.
[note]Using the [b]continue [/b]statement outside of a loop causes an error.[/note]

resolved.title: 计算票价
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在开发一个票务系统：
一张票的价格是100元，但是对于3岁以下的儿童，门票是免费的。

程序需要将5名乘客的年龄作为输入，输出他们的票价总额。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]continue[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a ticketing system. 
The price of a single ticket is $100.
For children under 3 years old, the ticket is free.

Your program needs to take the ages of 5 passengers as input and output the total price for their tickets.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
18
24
2
5
42

[b]Sample Output [/b]
400

[note]There is one child under 3 among the passengers, so the total price of 5 tickets will be [b]$400[/b].[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
total = 0
i = 0
while i < 5:
	age = int(input())
	i = i +1
	if age < 3:
		continue
	total +=100
print (total)

testcases.explanation: 乘客中有3个3岁以下的孩子，所以5张票的总价格将是 **200**
